_comment: Trigger routing cases — forge suite plus explicit maximum-effort invocations. `expect` lists every acceptable answer; 'none' means no skill should trigger. Near-miss sibling pairs catch descriptions that steal or lose routing. Maximum-effort is explicit-only by description: ordinary work without a Maximum Effort or cheap-agent request must not trigger it. Generic session phrases (keep going, review this, remember this, retro) are expected to route to none so forge does not fire outside forge work; code-review is the harness built-in and counts as not-forge.
